facts.text: The Jane P. Batten Honors College awards 20 full-tuition and 20 nearly three-quarters tuition scholarships each year.

sources.title: Program Advantages| Jane P. Batten Honors College
sources.quote: Students admitted to the Jane P. Batten Honors College are awarded either a full-tuition or a nearly three-quarters tuition scholarship — 20 scholarships of each amount, every year.
